takeaway.text: Human resilience narratives dominated HN today: a practitioner's account of rebuilding after addiction, prison, and a felony scored 545 HN points — the highest single-day score in recent weeks — arriving the same day DeepSeek V4 Pro matched GPT-5.5 Pro on precision benchmarks at 98% lower cost, turbovec delivered a no-train-step vector index from the ICLR 2026 TurboQuant paper, and Lobsters' top story by 222 points was a CS professor writing directly to students about vibecoding's pedagogical consequences. The compound picture is a community simultaneously reckoning with what AI tools can substitute for (entry-level credentialing, code generation, model hosting costs) and what they cannot (foundational understanding, human testimony, precision physical craftsmanship).
